description: This file defines utility methods for handling emojis, including skin tones and gender modifiers, in Java. It provides functions to identify emoji labels and extract skin tone and gender information from text.

classes.name: JavaEmojiUtils
classes.description: A utility class providing methods to analyze and extract emoji-related information such as skin tones and gender modifiers from text.

classes.name: JavaEmojiUtils.SkinTone
classes.description: An enum representing different skin tone modifiers for emojis.

classes.name: JavaEmojiUtils.Gender
classes.description: An enum representing gender modifiers for emojis.

methods.name: isLabelOfEmoji
methods.description: Checks if the given label is an emoji label based on its first character.

methods.name: getAllSkinTones
methods.description: Extracts all skin tone modifiers present in the given text.

methods.name: getAllGenders
methods.description: Extracts all gender modifiers present in the given text.
